catalog.capacity: Inspect a named cluster's hardware, occupancy, and available capacity for recipe placement.
catalog.cleanup: Remove abandoned staged recipe imports while preserving retained imports.
catalog.clusters: List saved cluster definitions for catalog selection without probing hosts.
catalog.import: Stage supplied recipe content for preview and resolution, preserving its imported provenance.
catalog.recipe: Inspect one recipe's configuration, metadata, and validation details, optionally checking its expected revision.
catalog.recipes: Browse cached recipe summaries with filters, pagination, and facets; does not refresh registries.
catalog.refresh: Refresh enabled recipe registries from their remote sources.
catalog.registries: List configured recipe registries and their enabled, stemless, and trust settings.
catalog.registries.add: Add a named recipe registry from a URL; adding it does not grant trust.
catalog.registries.disable: Disable a registry while retaining its saved configuration.
catalog.registries.enable: Enable a configured recipe registry for discovery and resolution.
catalog.registries.remove: Remove a registry from configuration so it no longer participates in recipe discovery.
catalog.registries.trust: Grant a registry standing trust for recipe execution after explicit acknowledgement.
catalog.registries.untrust: Revoke a registry's standing trust for recipe execution.
catalog.retain: Keep a staged imported recipe so later cleanup does not remove it.
cluster.create: Save a new named cluster with its hosts, description, and optional SSH user.
cluster.default: Select the default saved cluster, or clear the selection with a null name.
cluster.delete: Delete a saved cluster definition without stopping its running workloads.
cluster.update: Change a saved cluster's hosts, description, or SSH user.
diagnostics.collect: Collect a bounded diagnostic bundle for configuration, hosts, and optional workload logs.
discovery.snapshot: Observe healthy workload endpoints with coverage and errors; metadata-only mode probes recorded endpoints without an SSH sweep.
model_cache.adopt: Preview or enroll existing untracked model snapshots in usage tracking without downloading or moving files.
model_cache.delete: Preview or explicitly delete a model or revision, preserving blobs still used by other snapshots.
model_cache.import: Import a supplied manifest or explicitly resolve one from the model origin, then report target-cache completeness without downloading weights.
model_cache.inspect: Check selected model files against their manifest and report missing, invalid, or unreadable cache content.
model_cache.list: Inventory tracked model-cache revisions, byte accounting, usage, pins, and active claims.
model_cache.pin: Add or remove a retention pin for an exact model revision on the selected hosts.
model_cache.prune: Preview or apply age- and budget-based cleanup of eligible model-cache revisions, preserving protected content.
model_cache.reconcile: Release an exact stale cache claim after the caller confirms its workloads are inactive; does not delete model files.
model_cache.repair: Acquire or copy missing and invalid model files, then validate the repaired caches.
model_cache.resolve: Resolve a model and revision into an immutable manifest of the selected files.
proxy.add_alias: Save an additional public model name pointing at a gateway target.
proxy.discovery.ensure: Ensure the current gateway generation has a dedicated discovery service and return its daemon job ID.
proxy.discovery.status: Read the gateway discovery service's ownership, scope, and health state.
proxy.discovery.stop: Stop the dedicated gateway discovery service without stopping inference workloads.
proxy.install_service: Install the persistent proxy systemd service, optionally starting it immediately.
proxy.list_aliases: List saved gateway model aliases without launching a gateway.
proxy.list_gateways: List registered gateway providers and their availability.
proxy.models: Query the running gateway for its registered models.
proxy.register_loaded_model: Record a loaded recipe and its overrides for gateway discovery; does not launch inference.
proxy.remove_alias: Remove a saved gateway model alias.
proxy.resolve_gateway: Resolve an explicit or configured gateway provider and validate its availability.
proxy.service_status: Inspect the proxy systemd unit and optionally retrieve recent journal output.
proxy.start: Discover endpoints, prepare the selected gateway, and start its service and configured discovery backend.
proxy.status: Inspect the running gateway and its discovery status.
proxy.stop: Stop the gateway and its discovery service while leaving inference workloads running.
proxy.sync: Refresh the gateway's model configuration from discovered endpoints, aliases, and optional host filters.
proxy.uninstall_service: Remove the installed proxy systemd service, or preview its removal.
proxy.unregister_loaded_model: Remove a recipe from saved gateway load tracking; does not itself stop inference.
recipes.validate: Validate a recipe and its overrides, returning structured issues without launching it.
setup.ensure_local_key: Find a usable local SSH key or generate one when requested.
setup.mesh_ssh_keys: Distribute public keys to establish SSH access among the selected hosts, or preview the changes.
setup.plan: Probe hosts and produce a hardware-aware setup plan without applying it.
setup.probe_hosts: Collect host reachability, hardware, and setup check results without applying fixes.
setup.probe_ssh_access: Check whether the selected hosts accept SSH using the requested user and key.
setup.rdma_test: Run the selected RDMA diagnostic suite and return per-link or collective performance results.
setup.run_steps: Apply selected setup steps with progress, credential prompts, and recovery manifests, or preview them.
setup.undo: Undo eligible setup steps recorded in a named cluster's recovery manifest.
tailscale.down: Disconnect selected hosts from Tailscale, optionally removing the installation.
tailscale.expose: Configure Tailscale exposure for a cluster endpoint or gateway.
tailscale.join: Install Tailscale on selected hosts and initiate joining the tailnet with the requested settings.
tailscale.status: Inspect Tailscale installation, connection, and address information on selected hosts.
workloads.endpoints: Observe credential-free workload endpoints for the requested binding and report live coverage or metadata-only evidence.
workloads.ensure_ready: Adopt, recover, or launch an exact recipe revision and return a verified ready endpoint with ownership and effect receipts.
workloads.inventory: List recorded workloads and unfinished activations with ownership, lifecycle actions, and a completeness flag.
workloads.plugins: List plugin inventory and identify enabled, loaded plugins that provide workload lifecycle controls.
workloads.reconcile: Reconcile uncertain effects for an exact workload after verifying its revision, ownership, and placement evidence.
workloads.sleep: Ask the owning lifecycle provider to put an exact workload to sleep when that action is supported.
workloads.status: Ask the lifecycle provider for the current state of an exact workload and record the observation.
workloads.stop: Stop an exact workload and recipe revision with manager ownership checks and durable effect tracking.
workloads.wake: Ask the owning lifecycle provider to wake an exact workload when that action is supported.
plugins.k8s.cluster_info: Inspect the selected Kubernetes cluster and optionally pin its kubectl version to the server release.
plugins.k8s.configure_service_account: Prepare a Kubernetes service account and access configuration, optionally creating its namespace and writing kubeconfig.
plugins.k8s.ensure_kubectl: Find and validate kubectl, optionally downloading the requested version.
plugins.k8s.jobset_status: Read a named JobSet's identity, namespace, and status without exposing its full pod specification.
plugins.k8s.kueue_status: Check whether Kueue and JobSet custom resource definitions are installed on the selected cluster.
plugins.k8s.list_nodes: List Kubernetes nodes, optionally filtering by label selector or GPU availability.
plugins.k8s.setup_kueue: Check or install Kueue and JobSet components, with optional version selection and dry-run preview.
plugins.k8s.stop_jobset: Delete a named Kubernetes JobSet and its managed workload resources.
